Custom SQL Query & Visual Query Builder

Set Data Calculation Type = Custom SQL Query when you need full power. Prefer clicks over typing? Turn on Use Visual Query Builder and design JOINs, CTEs, windows, and filters visually — then chart the result.

Choose Custom SQL → enable Visual Query Builder → design → generated SQL → live chart

Data Calculation Type

Custom SQL Query — strong enough for complex analytics

Write real SELECT queries with CTEs, multi-table JOINs, window functions, aggregates, and dashboard placeholders. Validate with Test Query before going live.

  • CTEs (WITH …) for multi-step logic
  • JOINs across sale_order, partners, stock, and more
  • Window functions — running totals, ranks, partitions
  • Placeholders: {start_date} {end_date} {uid} {company_id}
  • Optional Materialized View cache for heavy SQL
  • SQL Row Limit + label/value column mapping to any chart
Use Visual Query Builder

The Visual Query Builder widget — with a real sales example

Below is the actual widget layout filled with a Monthly Sales Revenue example: source sale.order, partner JOIN, date/company filters, GROUP BY month, and generated SQL.

  • Source table + quick template + suggested joins
  • SELECT rows with DATE_TRUNC / SUM aliases (label, value)
  • LEFT JOIN res.partner on partner_id
  • WHERE with {start_date} / {company_id} placeholders
  • GROUP / ORDER + live Generated SQL preview
  • Test Query → Apply to Widget → chart as barLine
Proper examples

Ready query patterns you can copy and adapt

Start from proven patterns — then map label/value columns to barLine, KPI, list, and more.

  • Sales by Month — CTE + date_trunc + SUM → barLine
  • Top Customers — JOIN partner + ORDER + LIMIT → horizontalBar
  • Running Revenue — SUM() OVER (…) → area
  • Stock Health — CASE + HAVING → list
End-to-end

From builder to beautiful chart in four steps

Enable Custom SQL + Visual Query Builder, design the query, generate SQL, Test Query, then render as any widget type.

  • 1 — Set Data Calculation Type = Custom SQL Query
  • 2 — Turn on Use Visual Query Builder
  • 3 — Configure SELECT / JOIN / WHERE / GROUP (or write SQL)
  • 4 — Test Query → map columns → save the widget

Frequently asked questions

Click a question to expand the answer. Still unsure? Email us before you buy.

What is Odoo Dynamic Dashboard with AI?

Odoo Dynamic Dashboard with AI is a complete Dashboard Builder for Odoo 19. It lets you create an interactive Dynamic Dashboard, AI Dashboard, KPI Dashboard, and business boards (Sales, CRM, Inventory, Accounting, HR, Project) with drag-and-drop layouts, 50+ charts, SQL, filters, TV Mode, and AI-assisted generation.

How do I create a Dynamic Dashboard in Odoo?

Install Odoo Dynamic Dashboard with AI, open the Dashboard app, then either use ready-made templates, ask AI to generate a board from a keyword (for example “Sales”), or drag-and-drop widgets and connect Odoo models, SQL, Excel, Google Sheets, or external databases.

Is this app compatible with Odoo Community and Enterprise?

Yes. Dynamic Dashboard works on Odoo Community, Enterprise (on-premise), and Odoo.sh. Odoo Online (SaaS) does not allow third-party apps, so it cannot be installed there.

Which Odoo version is supported?

This listing is built and tested for Odoo 19. If you need the app for another version, contact us and we will guide you on availability.

Do I need Sales, CRM, Accounting, or Inventory installed first?

No. The app works on a standard Odoo setup. Extra sample boards for Sales, Purchase, Inventory, or Accounting appear automatically when those apps are already installed.

How difficult is it to create the first dashboard?

Very easy. You can:

  • Use ready-made example boards after install
  • Ask AI to generate a full dashboard from a keyword like “Sales”
  • Or drag widgets manually and configure them visually

Most teams have a useful board ready within minutes.

Are AI features included in the purchase price?

Yes. Creating dashboards with AI, generating items with AI, and chart insights are included in the module. You bring your own AI provider account/API key in Settings (OpenAI, Gemini, Claude, Cursor, etc.), so you keep control of usage, billing, and privacy. All core features — charts, SQL, Visual Query Builder, KPIs, filters, TV Mode, and sharing — work fully without enabling AI.

Which AI providers can I use?

You can connect leading providers from Settings (such as OpenAI, Google Gemini, Anthropic Claude, or Cursor). Choose the one that fits your company policy and budget.

Does AI automatically change my dashboards without approval?

No. AI first shows suggested widgets. You preview, select what you want, and only then save. Nothing is added until you confirm.

Can I generate widgets with a simple business keyword?

Yes. Choose keywords like Sales, Revenue, Inventory, CRM, Pipeline, Invoices, and more — or type your own custom keyword such as “Overdue invoices by salesperson.”

How many chart and widget types are included?

You get 50 visualization styles, including KPI tiles, scorecards, bars, lines, pies, funnels, gauges, maps, treemaps, Sankey, lists, to-do boards, and more.

Can I customize colors, legends, labels, and targets?

Yes. Each chart supports rich options: themes, legend position, data labels, stacked views, tooltips, animation, zoom, export, target numbers/progress bars, card layouts, and number formats.

Can one chart use data from more than one place?

Yes. You can combine Odoo records, visual queries, reusable analyses, extra chart series, files, Google Sheets, and external sources into one dashboard experience.

What data sources are supported?

You can build widgets from:

  • Odoo business records
  • Custom queries with a visual query builder
  • Excel and CSV files
  • Google Sheets
  • External APIs
  • Web scrape (URL → JSON path)
  • PostgreSQL, MySQL, and SQL Server
  • Reusable analyses, SQL/Python data marts, and materialized views
Is there a visual query builder, or do I need to write complex queries myself?

Both. Set Data Calculation Type = Custom SQL Query for full SELECT power (CTEs, JOINs, window functions, placeholders like {start_date}/{company_id}, Test Query). Enable Use Visual Query Builder to design the same SQL visually with source tables, suggested joins, SELECT/WHERE/GROUP/Window/CTE sections, quick templates, and live validation. Beginners can stay fully visual; power users can edit the generated SQL anytime.

Can I filter dashboards by date, team, or company?

Yes. Use global date ranges, linked filters, compare-with-previous-period, and automatic current-user / current-company filters so each person sees the right slice of data.

Can users drill down into chart details?

Yes. Click a segment to drill deeper, use breadcrumbs to go back up, and open the related Odoo records when you need the source documents.

Does it support KPI targets and alerts?

Yes. Set targets as numbers or progress bars, use item formulas ({m1}/{m2}), dynamic target lines by date range, CSV import/export for quotas, and get alerts when a KPI falls below your threshold — in the inbox and by email.

Can dashboards refresh automatically?

Yes. Widgets can refresh on intervals (seconds/minutes) or via realtime bus so every open viewer updates instantly. You can also refresh manually anytime.

Can I show dashboards on a TV or wallboard?

Yes. TV Mode can rotate dashboards or slideshow widgets automatically. Present Mode is ideal for meetings, with optional presenter notes.

Can I share a dashboard with people outside Odoo?

Yes. Create a secure share link with automatic expiry. You can also email snapshots and schedule recurring report emails for stakeholders.

What export formats are available?

Export dashboards and widgets as PNG, PDF, Excel, or CSV. Perfect for presentations, audits, and offline sharing.

Can I publish a dashboard into the Odoo main menu?

Yes. Publish any dashboard under a parent menu so your team opens it like a normal Odoo app screen.

How do access rights / roles work?

Four clear roles are included:

  • Dashboard User — view and interact
  • Dashboard Manager — design boards and widgets
  • Analysis Manager — advanced analyses and data marts
  • Administrator — full setup including external connections

You can also restrict individual dashboards and widgets to selected groups.

Is it multi-company ready?

Yes. Dashboards and items respect company boundaries so each entity keeps its own secure analytics space.

Does it support multiple currencies and number formats?

Yes. Show values in the right currency and choose Exact, English (K/M/B), or Indian (Lakh/Crore) number formats — including custom number systems.

Is right-to-left (RTL) and multi-language supported?

Yes. Layout can follow the user language automatically, or you can force left-to-right / right-to-left. Dashboard names and labels support Odoo translations.

Can I import or export dashboards between databases?

Yes. Export a dashboard configuration and import it into another database to speed up rollouts across companies or staging environments.

Are sample dashboards included?

Yes. You get a chart-type gallery, a sample partners board, and business demos (when related apps are installed) so you can evaluate immediately.

Will this slow down my Odoo system?

The app is designed for interactive analytics with refresh controls, reusable analyses, and optional data marts / fast cache options for heavier queries so everyday use stays smooth.

Do I get free support after purchase?

Yes. You get 90 days free support from the purchase date for installation help, configuration guidance, questions, and bug fixing (excluding data recovery).

How do updates work?

Purchase is per Odoo major version listing (for example Odoo 19). Check this Apps Store page for the latest build of your version, and contact us if you need migration guidance to a newer Odoo series.

Can you customize the module for our industry?

Absolutely. We can help with industry dashboards, extra connectors, branding, and implementation. Email nexgensolutionsodoo@gmail.com with your requirements.

Is there a demo before buying?

Yes. Email nexgensolutionsodoo@gmail.com to request a personalized walkthrough. We can show AI generation, TV Mode, KPIs, and filters on real scenarios.

What is the license type?

The app is sold on the Odoo Apps Store under the Odoo Proprietary License v1.0 (OPL-1) by NexGen Solutions. After purchase, you may use it on your Odoo databases according to the store terms.

Can I collaborate on a widget without leaving the dashboard?

Yes. Use Internal Chat (Discuss) on any widget, plus Quick Edit and Switch Layout to change name, theme, or chart type live on the board.

What are Reusable Analyses?

Analyses let you define metrics, dimensions, and filters once, then reuse that definition across KPIs, charts, and AI suggestions — so every board stays consistent.

Can I embed an Odoo screen or external page inside a dashboard?

Yes. Use odoo_view to embed a window action, or iframe to show an external URL inside the board.

Who should I contact for pre-sale or support questions?

Contact NexGen Solutions at nexgensolutionsodoo@gmail.com. We are happy to help before and after purchase.
